observed_result: Matrix2 explicitly maps first name and last name as separate input columns/aliases and exporter fields; multi-input Name is technically exportable but introduces avoidable export-configuration coupling. Choice-backed fields may also require separate human label vs canonical code handling.
decision: For each Python-bound field, close the chain GF Field Type → Stored Value → Export Column → Python Destination before finalizing the field. Use independent Single Line Text fields for first_name and last_name; do not use one compound Name field in the new SRWF scaffold. Review group/school label-code pairs under the same rule.
reopen_condition: Reopen only if Matrix2/Python input contract changes or an executed export/import compatibility test proves a different Gravity Forms representation is safer without data-shape loss.
